game_concept: A strategy race set in Coastal Port – Merchant Wharf, the merchant wharf: the sailor must handle storm gulls while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Signal Logic: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings.
theme: Coastal Port – Merchant Wharf: the merchant wharf
core_gameplay_loop: In Merchant Wharf, repeat each round: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the sailor ahead. Then check the safety value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the signal flag by solving code steps involving safety that move the sailor forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the signal flag first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Signal Logic
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Signal Logic' (Week 3 slot 9), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Merchant Wharf'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm gulls in Merchant Wharf.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
